name: Please Don't Sneeze!
source:
Hay fever sufferer Jamie forgets to take his medicine the morning before his date. Can he steer the date away from any risky pollen to finally get a date that ends in success?

Make smart choices on the date to make sure it lasts as long as possible for your date (Alexander) to get to know you.

[From [url=https://kalamosgames.itch.io/please-dont-sneeze]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
花粉症患者杰米在约会前一天早上忘记吃药。他能否让约会对象远离任何危险的花粉，最终获得一次成功的约会呢？

在约会时做出明智的选择，以确保约会对象（亚历山大）能够尽可能长时间地了解你。

[来自[url=https://kalamosgames.itch.io/please-dont-sneeze]itch.io[/url]]
